name: net_downed_grounded_pair
description: Flat26 two-seat single-PC FM02 Computer Room logical-down regression for XZ-only/nativeY hold. Canonical P_EX110 only, native TakeDamage lethal hits through hooked stat funnel, normal Triangle/network revive, both directions sequentially. Uses first checked-in safe waypoint only; never Save, warp, rawHP/pose/team/control write, protection or focus. Ground baseline is observed nativeY (not zero). Exact canonical position recording during attempted downed input and actual postrevive movement; no actual enemy shove or airborne landing claim.
qualificationGaps: Offline draft only; no actual run or pixel proof yet.
Historical VUH2465 Computer Room proof is documented in DOWNED_REVIVE.md; its20261019-151151 artifacts are not local here.
Calm Computer Room supplies no enemy shove; this checks unchanged flat-ground hold and control/revive, not collision push or airborne settling.
Calm-fixture3000ms Triangle covers60nativeframes at20FPS; lower FPS may still fail. Thorn pilot1600ms holds are unchanged. Missing actual native receipt fails; no blind debug-revive fallback.
Existing Recorder tracks world/room and canonical-address XYZ only; full scope, status identity and grounded moveState are checked at phase boundaries, not atomically on every recorded row.
